title: [ffmpeg] Fix embedding subtitles (#9063)
description:
Change command line parameters for ffmpeg when embedding subtitles.
Change to ‘-map 0:v -c:v copy -map 0:a -c:a copy’

comments.author: yan12125
comments.body: Sorry for the late response. Any broken example before this fix?

comments.author: thamwangjun
comments.body:
Hi, sorry, this is to fix [#9063](https://github.com/rg3/youtube-dl/issues/9063). As discussed in that issue, this is caused by certain lynda videos having empty streams.
The changes to the parameters enables ffmpeg to pick the correct working streams in those lynda videos, including other videos that come along with empty streams.

comments.author: yan12125
comments.body:
From http://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.html:

```
stream_type is one of following: ’v’ or ’V’ for video, ’a’ for audio, ’s’ for subtitle, ’d’ for data, and ’t’ for attachments.
```

Honestly I don't know what are data and attachments in media files, and I haven't seen any example with them. I guess not copying them does not cause problems :)

--- a/youtube_dl/postprocessor/ffmpeg.py
+++ b/youtube_dl/postprocessor/ffmpeg.py
@@ -363,8 +363,10 @@ def run(self, information):
         input_files = [filename] + sub_filenames
 
         opts = [
-            '-map', '0',
-            '-c', 'copy',
+            '-map', '0:v',
+            '-c:v', 'copy',
+            '-map', '0:a',
+            '-c:a', 'copy',
             # Don't copy the existing subtitles, we may be running the
             # postprocessor a second time
             '-map', '-0:s',
